description_en: Imports a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster or a serverless Kubernetes cluster to Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)
description_zh: 调用ImportK8sCluster接口导入容器服务K8s集群或Serverless K8s集群
kebab_example: aliyun edas import-k8s-cluster --cluster-id 9c28bbb9-0000-44b3-b953-54ef8a2d0be2 --namespace-id cn-beijing:doc --biz-mode 1 --enable-asm true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportK8sCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ACK cluster or serverless Kubernetes cluster. You can obtain the cluster ID by calling the GetK8sCluster operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181437.html
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID，可通过调用GetK8sCluster接口获取，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181437.html
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace. It is in the format of `Region ID:Identifier of the microservices namespace`. Example: `cn-hangzhou:doc`
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID。格式为“`地域ID:微服务空间标识符`”，例如：`cn-hangzhou:doc`
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the integration with Alibaba Cloud Service Mesh (ASM). Valid values:

true: Enables the integration with ASM.

false: Disables the integration with ASM
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启ASM：
true：开启
false：不开启
parameters.name: enable_asm
